Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Max. Max loved to run and play with his friends in the park. One day, Max saw a little boy named Tim playing with a red ball. Max wanted to play too, so he went up to Tim and said, "Can I play with you?"
Tim was very surprised and said, "Okay, Max, let's play!" Max picked up the ball and threw it for Tim. They had so much fun! But then, Max started to shiver because he was too cold. His friends tried to make him stop shiver, but Max was too hairy to listen. He knew he needed to go home and play again.
